| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Custom | Flexible | Flexible | Listed as add-on in the comparison table, but as included in the Enterprise section | Priority, guaranteed response times, dedicated CSM, 99.99% uptime SLA |

Webhook endpoints: Free 1, Pro 5, Scale 10, Enterprise flexible.

## Marketing Plans

| Plan | Price | Contacts/mo | Key limits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | 1,000 | 3 segments, 3 domains, no marketing analytics |
| Pro marketing | $40 | 5,000 | Unlimited segments and domains, marketing analytics |
| Pro marketing | $80 | 10,000 | Same as above |
| Pro marketing | $120 | 15,000 | Same as above |
| Pro marketing | $180 | 25,000 | Same as above |
| Pro marketing | $250 | 50,000 | Same as above |
| Pro marketing | $450 | 100,000 | Same as above |
| Pro marketing | $650 | 150,000 | Same as above |
| Enterprise | Custom | Custom | Priority support, dedicated IPs included, SSO included |

## Add-ons and Pay-as-you-go

- **Automations:** 10,000 runs included on paid plans. Beyond that, $0.0015 per run.
- **Inboxes:** 3 included. Additional inboxes are $1/month each on paid plans with pay-as-you-go enabled.
- **Domains:** +100 domains for $20/month (Pro and Scale).
- **Dedicated IPs:** $30/month on Scale, for senders over 3,000 emails/day.
- **SSO:** $150/month on Scale.

## Deliverability Features

- **Custom domains:** Free 3, Pro 10, Scale 1,000, Enterprise flexible.
- **Dedicated IPs:** Scale and Enterprise, with automatic warmup and monitoring.
- **Shared IPs:** Monitored and maintained on all plans.
- **Authentication:** DKIM, SPF, and DMARC on all plans.
- **Suppression list:** Automatically adds permanent bounces on all plans.
- **Bounce details and deliverability insights:** Available on all plans.
- **Deliverability expertise:** Personalized recommendations on Pro, Scale, and Enterprise.
- **Multi-region sending:** Available on all plans.

## Pricing Tiers

| Plan | Price | Included emails | Overage | Custom domains | Retention |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0.00/mo | 100/month | Not allowed | Up to 10 | "Full message retention" (no day count given) |
| Basic | $15.00/mo | From 10,000/month | $1.80 per 1,000 | 5 | 45 days |
| Pro | $16.50/mo | From 10,000/month | $1.30 per 1,000 | 10 | Up to 365 days (45-day default) |
| Platform | $18.00/mo | From 10,000/month | $1.20 per 1,000 | Unlimited | Up to 365 days (45-day default) |

- **Dedicated IPs:** Add-on starting at $50/month per IP. It requires sending 300,000+ emails per month and is only available on Pro or higher.
- **Custom retention add-on:** Starts at $5/month, available on Pro or higher.

## Deliverability Features

- "Industry-leading deliverability rates & speed" on all paid plans
- "Up to 4x faster than other providers" delivery speeds
- High-quality, vetted IPs
- DKIM, SPF, and DMARC authentication
- Automatic suppression and suppression management
- Granular bounce data and delivery, bounce, spam, and open rates
- Shared delivery statistics on the status page
- DMARC monitoring add-on starting at $14/month per domain

content.text:
## Recommendation: Postmark, if deliverability and reliability are your priority. Resend, if cost and developer experience matter more.

For most transactional email (password resets, receipts, notifications), I'd pick **Postmark**. If you're an early-stage product sending under about 50k emails a month, Resend is the cheaper and nicer-to-start option.

### Pricing (from their pricing pages, fetched today)

| | Resend | Postmark |
|---|---|---|
| Free | 3,000/mo (100/day cap), 3 domains | 100/mo |
| Entry paid | $20 for 50k | $15 for 10k (Basic) |
| Mid | $35 for 100k | Pro $16.50 and Platform $18 for 10k, with higher volumes costing more |
| Overage per 1,000 | $0.90 (Pro), $0.46–$0.80 (Scale) | $1.20–$1.80 |
| Dedicated IP | $30/mo, Scale plan only, for senders over 3k/day | $50/mo per IP, Pro or higher, 300k+ emails/mo |
| Retention | 30 days | 45 days, up to 365 days on Pro and Platform |

Volume pricing: Resend is cheaper per email at every tier I could see. Postmark's page showed only the 10k starting prices. I didn't see its higher-volume tiers, so check its volume slider before you compare at your actual volume.

### Deliverability
- **Both** offer DKIM, SPF and DMARC support, automatic suppression lists, bounce data, and monitored shared IPs.
- **Postmark** advertises vetted IPs and faster delivery, publishes delivery stats on its status page, and sells a DMARC monitoring add-on from $14/mo per domain. Its main differentiator is a long-standing transactional-only focus. That policy keeps its shared IP reputation clean. This is background knowledge rather than something the pricing page showed, so verify it.
- **Resend** offers multi-region sending on all plans and personalized deliverability advice from the Pro plan up. It also sells marketing email, which puts different kinds of traffic on its platform.

### How to choose
- **Pick Postmark** if a missed or delayed email costs you (login codes, billing). Its record and message-retention options also favor it.
- **Pick Resend** if you want a generous free tier, lower cost at volume, and a modern API/SDK. It also fits if you want transactional and marketing email in one place.

Pricing pages change often, and I only have the numbers above from the pages themselves. Confirm your expected monthly volume against both calculators before committing. If you tell me your volume and email types, I can narrow this down.

Sources: [Resend pricing](https://resend.com/pricing), [Postmark pricing](https://postmarkapp.com/pricing)
